title: James Randi's million-dollar paranormal challenge

tellings.quote: he had this show where at first he would give you 10 grand if you proved something paranormal would exist.

related.note: Both are about James Randi's paranormal challenge. The stored story claims the prize was really a 30-year payout that Randi judged himself, while this telling presents it as a straightforward cash prize that began at $10,000.

plain: From 1964 until 2015, a man named James Randi ran a challenge offering money to anyone who could prove that something paranormal exists. It started with a $10,000 prize and grew into the well-known million-dollar challenge. A researcher named Chris Ramsay describes it from memory, without naming a source, saying Randi "had this show where at first he would give you 10 grand if you proved something paranormal would exist."
